desc: Fix the four diagonal directions [(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,-1),(-1,1)] and clockwise mapping cw[i]=(i+1)%4 (confirmed clockwise via examples 1 and 2).
Precompute g0/g2 no-turn alternating-run tables for all 4 directions with correct reverse scan orders.
Compute h0/h2 turn-available tables per direction (continue via same-direction h; single clockwise turn via g of cell+cw(direction); stop allowed).
Assemble full Solution.lenOfVDiagonal with answer = max over value-1 cells of 1+h2, no-1 returns 0.
Run the 4 provided examples (produced 5,4,5,1 = expected) and cross-check against independent brute force on random small grids (all trials PASS, no counterexample).
Confirm O(n*m) time and acceptable memory for n,m up to 500; degenerate grids (all-1 / no-1) handled.
